description: This file defines the class LdapConfigurationController which extends AbstractVueController. It manages LDAP configuration view logic, initializing a Vue component with LDAP settings for rendering.

classes.name: LdapConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller managing LDAP configuration Vue component, extending AbstractVueController, utilizing ConfigServiceTrait to access LDAP settings and setting up the component accordingly.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the LDAP configuration component by fetching LDAP settings and adding the 'show-sync' property based on whether LDAP is enabled.
